title: Time to look for a lost ball
question: How much time do you have to look for your golf ball before it is considered lost under the Rules of Golf?
explanation: You have up to 3 minutes to search for your ball. If you don't find it within 3 minutes, it is classed as lost.

juniorVersion.title: How long can you look for your ball?
juniorVersion.question: If you can't see your golf ball after you hit it, how many minutes do you get to look for it before it is lost?
juniorVersion.explanation: You have three minutes to find your ball. If you can’t find it in three minutes, the ball is lost. Then you need to play another ball.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A ball is called lost if you can't find it in three minutes.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Use a timer or count together with children to show what three minutes feels like when looking for a ball.
likelyMisconceptions: Some children may think they have unlimited time to search.
Some may think the old five-minute rule still applies.
